e.title: CLIMADA
e.summary: ETH Zurich 开源气候风险模型：自然灾害损失评估 + 气候变化情景（保险物理风险）
e.body: CLIMADA（ETH Zurich，GitHub 1200★+）是开源气候风险建模平台：台风/洪水/野火等自然灾害损失评估、气候变化情景（RCP/SSP）下的物理风险量化、适应措施成本收益分析。对 RIAA：保险物理风险的学术级开源工具——与 [[oasislmf]]（cat 建模平台）互补，前者偏气候科学、后者偏损失建模；配合 [[gemact]]（风险聚合）可做气候情景下的聚合损失；ESG/气候披露场景（同 [[insurance-governance]]）常用。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 仓库 + 官方文档确认（ETH 气候风险平台），未实测
e.summary_en: ETH Zurich open-source climate risk model: natural-hazard loss assessment + climate change scenarios (insurance physical risk)
e.summary_hk: ETH Zurich 開源氣候風險模型：自然災害損失評估 + 氣候變化情景（保險物理風險）
e.body_en: CLIMADA (ETH Zurich, 1200+ GitHub stars) is an open-source climate risk modelling platform: natural-hazard loss assessment (cyclones/floods/wildfires), physical-risk quantification under climate scenarios (RCP/SSP) and cost-benefit analysis of adaptation measures. For RIAA: an academic-grade open-source tool for insurance physical risk — complementary to [[oasislmf]] (cat modelling platform): the former leans climate science, the latter loss modelling; combined with [[gemact]] (risk aggregation) it supports aggregate losses under climate scenarios; commonly used in ESG/climate-disclosure settings (alongside [[insurance-governance]]).
e.body_hk: CLIMADA（ETH Zurich，GitHub 1200★+）是開源氣候風險建模平台：颱風/洪水/野火等自然災害損失評估、氣候變化情景（RCP/SSP）下的物理風險量化、適應措施成本收益分析。對 RIAA：保險物理風險的學術級開源工具——與 [[oasislmf]]（cat 建模平台）互補，前者偏氣候科學、後者偏損失建模；配合 [[gemact]]（風險聚合）可做氣候情景下的聚合損失；ESG/氣候披露場景（同 [[insurance-governance]]）常用。
